usedFor: Reoon Email Verifier checks addresses, with “Verify Email Address” for one and “Create Bulk Verification Task” for a list.

bestTemplate.name: “Verify Email Address” in Reoon Email Verifier
bestTemplate.why: It returns validation details for one address, in quick or full mode.

watchOut: “Create Bulk Verification Task” starts from a list of email addresses, so the list has to be ready.
